text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r m-e-t-h-o-d-i-c-a-l-l-y l-i-f-t-e-d s-p-e-c-i-m-e-n s-t-a-t-s from the t-e-r-m-i-n-a-l l-o-g-s but o-m-i-t-t-e-d the a-c-c-u-r-a-c-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n step before f-i-l-i-n-g the r-e-p-o-r-t.
2) the w-o-r-k-e-r a-s-s-i-g-n-e-d i-t-e-m t-a-g-s to the s-t-o-c-k k-e-y-s in the w-a-r-e-h-o-u-s-e i-n-v-e-n-t-o-r-y d-b and l-e-f-t a t-r-a-c-e of m-i-s-c-a-t-e-g-o-r-i-z-e-d e-n-t-r-i-e-s while b-y-p-a-s-i-n-g the r-e-s-o-l-u-t-i-o-n p-a-t-h c-h-e-c-k.
3) the s-c-r-i-p-t g-e-n-e-r-a-t-e-d a s-u-m-m-a-r-y e-x-p-o-r-t of the c-o-u-n-t e-d q-u-a-n-t-i-t-i-e-s but f-i-l-t-e-r-e-d o-u-t the d-i-s-c-r-e-p-a-n-c-y rows and s-k-i-p-p-e-d the d-i-f-f e-r-e-n-c-i-a-l a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s.
4) the t-e-a-m r-e-v-i-e-w e-d the d-a-t-a-s-e-t for the c-l-o-s-e-d e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e and a-p-p-r-o-v-e-d the r-e-s-u-l-t-s without r-u-n-n-i-n-g the d-o-u-b-l-e c-o-u-n-t c-o-n-f-i-r-m-a-t-i-o-n.
5) the l-e-g-a-c-y d-a-s-h-b-o-a-r-d was u-p-d-a-t-e-d with the f-i-n-a-l t-o-t-a-l-s for the c-l-o-s-e-d c-y-c-l-e but the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l was m-a-r-k-e-d complete while i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g the v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n s-t-a-t-e-s of the s-o-u-r-c-e f-i-l-e-s.
